hypothesis_title: Parsimonious Crema-Breakdown Switch Predicts Coffee Cooling

strands.why: C3 achieves best BIC on 3/4 datasets and best drinkable-time prediction, but tau MLE hits sweep boundary (8 min); physics-based switching not uniquely identified vs free-transition/changepoint
Pre-registered survival rule yields no survivors at N=3 (degenerates to unanimity); methodological limitation, not scientific refutation

hypothesis_title: Newton's Law Inaccurate for 30-min Coffee Cooling

strands.why: Systematic Newton error of 6.0°C (CI [4.6, 7.4]) at 30 min is a robust, executed finding.
Dataset survey provided infrastructure, not a hypothesis test.
